plate.rule: each pixel of D2 (-86) is a ray from PD: plate-D2o where D2o's canvas sees it, plate-D1-ungraded on the left 5 deg (matched to D2o per material on the overlap next to the seam, linear light), a 2 deg cross-fade along D2o's left edge

niche.rule: the edit's niche inside the new clay's niche (ids 42 / 39) + 3 px, feathered, its walnut matched to the stage-one niche (the lit back panel under the top LED, one linear gain per channel, the LED lines kept); the rest is plate-D2-composed
